use_case_summary: Embeddings-first code search + contextual code assistant for internal devs. Primary flow: user query -> vector candidate retrieval from large embedding index (~120M vectors) -> light-weight reranker (LLM) to surface exact code snippets and call-site context. Must support frequent re-indexing (daily delta + weekly full rebuilds), sub-150ms p95 retrieval+rerank for IDE-style UX, and strict SSO/SAML + audit controls.
requirements: Corpus: ~120M code and doc embeddings (multi-repo, 10+TB raw), growth ~10-15%/month
Indexing cadence: daily incremental + weekly full reindex; reindex pipeline runs must not impact query SLOs
Latency SLO: end-to-end (retrieve + rerank) p95 <= 150ms; target p50 ~40ms
Throughput: 400 qps sustained during internal peak, spikes to 2k qps for nightly CI jobs
Cost target: <$0.0015 per query (embeddings+rerank) at scale
Security: Okta SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning, audit log retention 12 months, KMS-backed key management
Data residency: some repos in EU; support for region pinning or private deployment required
Operational: route-based observability, token-level cost breakdown, canary rollouts for reranker model changes
poc_details: 2-week POC: deploy a Dedicated cluster in NA region, load 5M subset (mixed C# / Python / infra-as-code), run synthetic query suite (500k queries) to measure latency/cost, test Okta SSO in staging, demonstrate safe canary for reranker model updates.
technical_notes: Currently using hybrid retrieval: sparse BM25 -> ANN recall -> LLM reranker. Customer wants Redwood to own vector storage+ANN layers or integrate with existing Vespa instance.
Strong preference for 8-bit quantized model variants for reranking to reduce GPU memory and cost. Concern: quality regressions vs float16.
Reindex pipeline: Airflow-based, heavy I/O. Wants background compaction + zero-downtime swaps for indexes.
Key integration ask: system-to-system SAML handshake + SCIM user provisioning; vendor wants JIT provisioning and SSO for developer sandbox accounts.
Customer is sensitive to per-token rerank costs — interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (batching, KV caching, smaller reranker models)
